# Historical case import format

<!-- Generated by `make schema` from `apps/api/src/loancopilot/history.py`. -->

Upload a JSONL file (one JSON object per line) in **Admin → History import**. Each line
is one past application with its lender decisions. The format has **no name fields**:
historical cases are pseudonymous and get IDs like `H-0042`. Unknown fields are
rejected, and every `lender_name` must match a lender created in the app.

Outcomes (`decisions`) are never embedded; only the profile fields are used to find
similar cases.

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required |
|---|---|---|
| `company` | object | yes |
| `company.legal_form` | one of `bv`, `eenmanszaak`, `vof`, `other` | yes |
| `company.sbi_code` | text | yes |
| `company.founded_year` | integer | yes |
| `company.employees` | integer | yes |
| `company.region` | text | yes |
| `application` | object | yes |
| `application.applied_on` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | yes |
| `application.amount` | number | yes |
| `application.purpose` | one of `working_capital`, `equipment`, `real_estate`, `refinancing`, `growth`, `other` | yes |
| `application.term_months` | integer | yes |
| `financials` | list of objects | yes |
| `financials[].year` | integer | yes |
| `financials[].revenue` | number | no |
| `financials[].cost_of_sales` | number | no |
| `financials[].gross_profit` | number | no |
| `financials[].operating_expenses` | number | no |
| `financials[].ebitda` | number | no |
| `financials[].depreciation` | number | no |
| `financials[].interest_expense` | number | no |
| `financials[].net_income` | number | no |
| `financials[].total_assets` | number | no |
| `financials[].current_assets` | number | no |
| `financials[].cash` | number | no |
| `financials[].equity` | number | no |
| `financials[].current_liabilities` | number | no |
| `financials[].long_term_debt` | number | no |
| `cashflow_summary` | object | yes |
| `cashflow_summary.avg_monthly_inflow` | number | yes |
| `cashflow_summary.negative_balance_days` | integer | yes |
| `cashflow_summary.top_customer_share` | number | yes |
| `cashflow_summary.existing_annual_debt_service` | number | yes |
| `decisions` | list of objects | yes |
| `decisions[].lender_name` | text | yes |
| `decisions[].decision` | one of `approved`, `declined`, `withdrawn` | yes |
| `decisions[].amount_granted` | number | no |
| `decisions[].interest_rate` | number | no |
| `decisions[].term_months` | integer | no |
| `decisions[].decline_reason` | text | no |
| `decisions[].documents_requested` | list of texts | no |
| `decisions[].decided_on` | date (YYYY-MM-DD) | yes |

Money is in EUR. `financials` holds one entry per year; any figure may be omitted.

## Example line (placeholder values)

```json
{"company": {"legal_form": "bv", "sbi_code": "4322", "founded_year": 2014, "employees": 25, "region": "Overijssel"}, "application": {"applied_on": "2024-03-15", "amount": 250000, "purpose": "equipment", "term_months": 60}, "financials": [{"year": 2023, "revenue": 2500000, "ebitda": 300000, "equity": 700000, "total_assets": 1800000}], "cashflow_summary": {"avg_monthly_inflow": 210000, "negative_balance_days": 0, "top_customer_share": 0.22, "existing_annual_debt_service": 60000}, "decisions": [{"lender_name": "Example Lender", "decision": "approved", "amount_granted": 200000, "interest_rate": 0.072, "term_months": 60, "decline_reason": null, "documents_requested": ["A cash-flow forecast"], "decided_on": "2024-04-02"}]}
```
